results.description:
Deck-Man (formerly referred to as "duo-man") is a playful music player that brings the look, feel, and simplicity of classic portable cassette players to your iPhone Duo.
Turn your phone into a retro cassette player. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases. Just your music, with a little nostalgia.

A Cassette Player Reimagined:
Open your phone, browse your favorite albums as cassette tapes, insert one into the player, and close it to start listening.

The Little Details make that make it fun:
Browse your albums as cassette tapes and load them into your player.
Enjoy familiar play, pause, fast-forward, and rewind controls.
Hear authentic mechanical clicks and cassette sounds recorded from a real portable cassette player.
Enjoy playful interactions inspired by the original cassette-playing experience.

Your Music Your Way
Listen to your favorite albums with support for Apple Music and local music files.

Buy Once.
No ads. No Upsells. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No interruptions.


Deck-Man has been featured by TechCrunch, 9to5Mac, MacRumors, and TechRadar for its imaginative take on the classic portable cassette player.
